definition.title: Scan artifact drift
definition.description: Scan repository documentation, examples, evaluations, and metadata for drift with Concord.

definition.title: Capture failure evidence
definition.description: Create a redacted CaseFile evidence bundle from an existing local log file.

definition.title: Run quiet workflow
definition.description: Run a repository-defined Muzzle workflow with bounded output and its safety policy.

definition.title: Validate Kennel project
definition.description: Validate the local Kennel manifest and dependency declarations without installing packages.

definition.title: Install Kennel dependencies
definition.description: Resolve and install the dependencies declared by a local Kennel project.

definition.title: Run Dispatch workflow
definition.description: Execute a validated Dispatch workflow and retain its local run evidence.

definition.title: Ingest local knowledge
definition.description: Ingest a bounded local path into the configured Kujo RAG namespace.

definition.title: Record Watchdog telemetry
definition.description: Submit one metadata-only correlated event to an optional loopback Kujo Watchdog service.

definition.title: Scan document for sensitive data
definition.description: Scan a bounded local text or Markdown document with a canonical Redact policy and retain a metadata-only audit run.

definition.title: Sanitize sensitive document
definition.description: Create a deterministic redacted copy of a bounded local text or Markdown document and verify the result.

definition.title: Validate VersionSeal records
definition.description: Validate the checksums and contracts in a local VersionSeal state directory without changing approvals.

definition.title: Validate agent pack
definition.description: Deterministically validate an existing PackWrite agent execution pack.

definition.title: Summarize agent pack
definition.description: Summarize an existing PackWrite pack, including phases, missing files, warnings, and next action.

definition.title: Generate agent pack
definition.description: Generate and validate a PackWrite execution pack from a local mega-prompt through a configured provider.

definition.title: Start RunLedger record
definition.description: Start a local RunLedger record for an agent run and capture its initial git state.

definition.title: Finish RunLedger record
definition.description: Finalize a local RunLedger record with an explicit status and verdict.

definition.title: Validate decision proposal
definition.description: Validate a consequential decision proposal against Tribunal's bounded input contract without starting a hearing.

definition.title: Run offline decision hearing
definition.description: Run a deterministic credential-free Tribunal hearing and retain its sealed local decision evidence.

definition.title: Validate evidence ledger
definition.description: Validate record contracts, checksums, and append-only events in a local Dossier state directory.

definition.title: Report evidence ledger
definition.description: Read a bounded report of claims, sources, evidence, conflicts, quotations, consent, freshness, and rights records.

definition.title: Validate showcase manifest
definition.description: Validate a Howl showcase manifest and every referenced example without rendering artifacts.

definition.title: Render showcase artifacts
definition.description: Render deterministic SVG, Markdown, or HTML showcase artifacts and a local gallery from a Howl manifest.

definition.title: Validate browser flow
definition.description: Validate a Lens browser flow's structure and safety constraints without launching a browser.

definition.title: Check rendered page
definition.description: Open a local or explicitly allowed external page in a real browser and retain deterministic Lens QA evidence.

definition.title: Discover Kujo Capabilities
definition.description: List installed Paperclip projections and canonical Kujo ecosystem capabilities with profile, feature, runtime and authorization states. Catalog availability is not permission to execute.

definition.title: List Kujo Evidence
definition.description: List retained Kujo receipts for the current project, run, or assigned issue. Results distinguish observed, supplied and legacy evidence; they do not imply project tests passed. Issue scope requires issueId and the current assigned host run.

issueId.description: Required only for issue scope; verified against the assigned current host run.

definition.title: Read Kujo Evidence
definition.description: Read one integrity-checked, redacted evidence export in the current project, run, or assigned issue, limited to 64 KiB. Does not attach or mutate host documents. Issue scope requires issueId and the current assigned host run.

issueId.description: Required only for issue scope; verified against the assigned current host run.

definition.title: Check Kujo Source
definition.description: Check and lint one Git-visible .kujo file in the current project. Does not execute source or modify files; results do not verify imports, project tests or runtime behavior.

path.description: Relative .kujo path from this project's source catalog

definition.title: Preview Kujo Formatting
definition.description: Explicitly read one Git-visible .kujo source file and return a bounded, redacted original/formatted preview. Does not write files or apply fixes.

path.description: Relative .kujo path from this project's source catalog

definition.title: Understand Repository
definition.description: Map the current project with bounded Scout analysis: structure, languages, dependencies, routes and heuristic observations. Does not modify project files or execute project code. Source content requires a separate Context Pack read.

definition.title: Generate Review Pack
definition.description: Measure and summarize the current project changes without modifying the workspace.

definition.title: Capture Failure Evidence
definition.description: Turn bounded failure text into a redacted, persistent evidence record. This does not execute commands.

definition.title: Get Context Pack
definition.description: Select bounded, task-relevant files from the current Paperclip project workspace.

definition.title: Read Context Pack Content
definition.description: Read safe, redacted content for files already selected by a Context Pack.

definition.title: Import Verification Evidence
definition.description: Retain a redacted summary of supplied canonical evaluation-result JSON in the current project. Classifies skipped, partial, blocked and failed claims explicitly. Does not execute checks, authenticate the producer, or verify referenced evidence.

json.description: Supplied kujo.evaluation-result/v1 JSON, at most 64 KiB. References are not opened.

definition.title: Review Task Contract
definition.description: Validate one Git-visible Kujo Spec contract with pinned native tools. Inspect acceptance criteria and declared checks without executing them, granting approvals or changing workspace files.

path.description: Relative .spec.json, .spec.yml, .spec.yaml or .spec.toml path from the project contract catalog

strict.description: Treat canonical validation warnings as contract validation failure

definition.title: Inspect Architecture
definition.description: Inspect import boundaries using the pinned native Fence policy in a bounded Git-visible snapshot. Reports coverage and the configured threshold; never runs project commands or tests.

definition.title: Inspect Artifact Drift
definition.description: Inspect documentation, examples, task contracts and metadata with canonical Concord in a bounded private snapshot. Reports experimental drift leads and coverage; never executes project code.

definition.title: Inspect Release Readiness
definition.description: Inspect canonical ShipCheck readiness signals on bounded artifact copies and actual host workspace Git metadata. Never executes tests or linters and does not certify a release.

definition.title: Run Approved Evaluation
definition.description: Inspect an issue Eval suite, request human approval, start the approved frozen inputs, or list/read/cancel retained executions. Requires the current assigned issue run. Never accepts commands, workspace paths or approval IDs. Approval is resolved by a human on the issue; preparation never executes tests. Cancellation remains available after disabling execution.

definition.title: Inspect Kujo Packages
definition.description: Inspect a Git-visible Kennel manifest and adjacent lockfile using canonical offline parsing and manifest validation. Does not resolve, install, verify installed bytes, access the network or run project code.

path.description: Git-visible kennel.toml path relative to the host workspace.

definition.title: Run Approved Kujo Source or Tests
definition.description: Inspect or request human approval for a fixed Kujo run, test-run or fixture-test command on a bounded frozen issue-workspace copy; start, inspect or cancel retained executions. Trusted code is not sandboxed. No commands, runtime flags, caller roots or approval IDs are accepted. Requires the assigned current issue run; only a human accepts approval.

path.description: Git-visible .kujo entry file for run/test; omit for tests/ fixture mode.
Git-visible .kujo entry file for run/test; omit for tests/ fixture mode.

definition.title: Create an Approved Kujo Starter
definition.description: Preview canonical script/API/MCP/agent files, request human-only issue approval and explicitly create a new directory in the host-owned workspace. Never overwrites files, installs dependencies or executes generated programs. Partial creation is not rolled back or retried. Agent requires current assigned issue/run; no caller root or file bytes.

definition.title: Run Approved Kujo Workflows
definition.description: Preview shipped offline Dispatch examples, request human confirmation, explicitly queue approved operations, inspect retained state, and cancel owned work. Human checkpoint decisions require a human action and a fresh confirmation. No agent paths, live providers, arbitrary programs or automatic replay.

definition.title: Project Knowledge
definition.description: Explicitly index selected project text locally, query retained snapshots with citations, inspect freshness, or delete private indexes. Discovery lists names only. No external provider or project code runs. Index creation and replacement require explicit paths and the current revision (null for a new index).

definition.title: Inspect Dispatch run
definition.description: Inspect retained canonical run state without resuming or retrying it. Canonical SQLite inspection may initialize storage bookkeeping.

definition.title: Find retained Dispatch runs
definition.description: Discover retained run IDs before retrying an uncertain workflow. Canonical Dispatch may repair its run index.

definition.title: Decide inspected Dispatch checkpoint
definition.description: Apply one explicitly reviewed human checkpoint decision at the inspected revision through canonical Dispatch. May continue subsequent workflow effects, but never auto-approves later checkpoints.

definition.title: Preview repository MCP generation
definition.description: Classify the current repository and preview output paths with the canonical offline MCP generator; no generated files or discovered commands are executed.

definition.title: Generate guarded repository MCP scaffold
definition.description: Generate and validate canonical MCP scaffolds offline into a new contained directory after approval. Never overwrite existing outputs; inspect retained safety and validation reports before exposing the server.

definition.title: Run Agents SDK offline examples
definition.description: Execute the pinned canonical Agents SDK offline example suite after approval; validate each example acceptance flag, preserving intentional rejected-approval status.

definition.title: Preview offline knowledge
definition.description: Review the local Markdown/text/Kujo corpus and exact digest before indexing. Hidden files, node_modules, dist and vendor are excluded. At most 128 files and 8 MiB.

definition.title: Build reviewed offline knowledge
definition.description: Build the exact reviewed corpus through canonical RAG with local hash embeddings. Replace the managed index transactionally after one-time approval.

definition.title: Inspect knowledge freshness
definition.description: Compare the managed corpus digest with current files and runtime provenance. Does not query or rebuild.

definition.title: Query current offline knowledge
definition.description: Query a current managed index through canonical RAG with citations. Refuses missing or stale indexes.

definition.title: Recover knowledge installation
definition.description: Explicitly recover a stopped managed index installation. Refuses live owners. Recheck freshness afterward.

definition.title: Link RunLedger evidence
definition.description: Record an explicit Watchdog trace or Eval run link in canonical RunLedger without copying evidence or changing the verdict. Supply at least one link.

definition.title: Inspect Leash configuration
definition.description: Inspect local Leash opt-in configuration without a network call.

definition.title: Submit a Leash intervention
definition.description: Send one reviewed canonical intervention event to the configured Leash service. Does not grant native permissions or observe a human decision.

origin.description: Exact configured service origin from kujo_leash_status; bound to this approval.

event.description: Canonical Leash event: include request_id for kujo.intervention-request/v2 or event_id for a legacy event. Preserve that identity exactly for acknowledgement and reconciliation. Leash validates the full event.

schema.description: Use kujo.intervention-request/v2 for a v2 request; preserve the supplied canonical schema.

request_id.description: Required identity for kujo.intervention-request/v2. Copy the supplied request_id exactly; do not omit or generate a replacement.

event_id.description: Required identity for legacy intervention events. Copy the supplied event_id exactly.

definition.title: Discover application gateway Abilities
definition.description: List configured application gateway tools with canonical identities, effects and execution paths.

definition.title: Execute reviewed gateway Ability
definition.description: Execute a reviewed application Ability after separate native approval. Gateway authentication, tenant permissions and server approval remain authoritative.

tool.description: Exact descriptor returned by kujo_gateway_list; reviewed again before execution.

approval_id.description: Optional approval issued by the application. Native approval does not create this.

definition.title: Read configured Watchdog telemetry
definition.description: Read a bounded API response from an explicitly configured local or HTTPS Watchdog service. Does not enable lifecycle delivery or proxy model calls.

path.description: /api/* path with optional query filters, /healthz or /readyz.

definition.title: Check and lint Kujo source
definition.description: Check and lint Kujo source using the canonical installed runtime on a private copy, without executing the program or modifying source. Single UTF-8 .kujo file, at most 64 KiB.

definition.title: Preview Kujo formatting
definition.description: Preview Kujo formatting using the canonical installed runtime on a private copy, without executing the program or modifying source. Single UTF-8 .kujo file, at most 64 KiB.

definition.title: Preview source execution
definition.description: Preview a canonical Kujo run/test command and an explicit multi-file snapshot with digests. Include imports, resources and test expected outputs; no program execution.

definition.title: Run reviewed Kujo source or tests
definition.description: Execute the exact digest-bound source snapshot after human approval. Canonical Kujo run or test, 120-second window, retained output directory. Trusted code may perform host filesystem, process and network effects; this is not an OS sandbox.

definition.title: Preview canonical starter
definition.description: Preview every file from canonical script/fixture-agent generators or pinned API/MCP application sources. No project writes, dependency install or program execution. Review the returned creation_input and file contents.

definition.title: Create canonical starter
definition.description: Create the exact reviewed starter bytes in a new contained directory after approval. Refuse digest changes and existing destinations. Retain partial failures; never install dependencies or start generated programs.

definition.title: Inspect canonical starter
definition.description: Compare the reviewed starter inventory against current destination files after creation or interruption. Reports matching, missing and changed bytes without modifying files; additional files are not inspected.
